_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Forty-seventh scheduled run. 16 of 22 URLs served and 10,440 product pages reviewed, a new high. NO NEW MATCHES against the chart anywhere, and every site with a feed answered on the first attempt.

KATE ROSES GREW 113 -> 135 PRODUCTS, the largest single-run addition on that site since it joined and 22 listings in one go, with no addition matching a chart name. Kisaki Plant grew 368 -> 371 and Rose Explosion 1,476 -> 1,477. Hillside Rose Farm fell 160 -> 152.

HILLSIDERO-005 and -007 are both gone again, each one run after returning, each confirmed by HTTP 404. That is -005's ninth disappearance since 2026-10-19 and -007's second since its case was created on 2026-11-09. Eight listings stand removed in total, each confirmed by HTTP 404: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001, HILLSIDERO-004, -005 and -007, SPRINGLAND-004. 450 of 464 cases verified present.

SPRINGLAND-008 IS A STANDING CASE OF ITS OWN and will read oddly from here. The seller retitled it on 2026-11-16, removing the chart name "Royal Diva" while keeping "Opera Queen", so it no longer matches anything in the chart and will appear on the "served but not in its feed" list on every run from now on. It is NOT removed: its URL answered HTTP 200 again today. The check that matters for this case is its URL, not the match list, and the case now says so.

ALL 17 EVIDENCE PACKS WERE REBUILT AND DELIVERED, as arranged on 2026-11-16. The pack state file was deliberately deleted that day so this run would rebuild them all and send them through the ordinary path: the content has not changed, only the new status line on each card, which says whether the listing is LIVE, REMOVED BY THE SELLER or NOT RE-CHECKED, with a count in each pack's opening line.

Screenshots 414 of 464; Registered coverage 71 of 75. The three capturable Registered gaps are HIGHGARDEN-011, -018 and -024, all of which became Registered on 2026-11-16 and are the highest-value captures available to the user.

Mola Rose and Muse Roses reported identical catalog sizes and identical match counts for the sixteenth consecutive run (791 / 48 each).

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.

Etsy storefront, added to the roster 2026-11-03. Etsy publishes no open product feed and etsy.com is unreachable from this environment (HTTP 403 at the proxy's CONNECT stage), so this seller cannot be crawled and is a standing coverage gap. Its five cases, COMMERCEFA-001..005, were built on 2026-11-03 from listing URLs and screenshots the user gathered by hand; they are not re-verified by this run and their Last Verified dates deliberately did not move.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Served at 216 products, unchanged. MYROSEWORL-001..003 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 174 products, unchanged. HILLSIDERO-005 still present; -004 still removed (HTTP 404).
Shopify storefront; the store's own product feed answered normally and returned zero products. The catalog is empty, not unreachable -- the site was checked in full.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.
Served at 62 products, unchanged. KATEROSES-001 and -002 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Served at 1,943 products, up 56 from 2026-10-26 and 88 over three runs. None of the additions matched a chart name.
